sources_note: Headlines summarised from reporting published 24 Nov 2026.

stories.headline: AI stocks roar back as Huang returns
stories.summary: Nvidia jumped 31% as Jensen Huang returned as CEO; the Nasdaq rose 6.5%, the S&P 500 4.5% and Taiwan 9% as the AI sell-off reversed. Short sellers lost $12.2bn.

stories.headline: Russian war death toll nears 700,000
stories.summary: Media studying leaked Russian government data put the war's death toll near 700,000 — the grimmest accounting yet.

stories.headline: Senate probes Vance's Venezuela oil link
stories.summary: A Senate panel is investigating JD Vance's ties to a prized Venezuelan oil contract, Reuters reported.

stories.headline: Australia to fine tech firms 5% of revenue
stories.summary: Tech companies face fines of up to 5% of global revenue for breaching Australia's internet safety bill.

stories.headline: Kenya clears its last Ebola patient
stories.summary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient as the death toll in neighbouring DR Congo passed 5,300.

stories.headline: Congo bans cobalt exports
stories.summary: Congo banned cobalt exports to halt a slide in the price of the battery metal, a move that rattles the supply chain for electric-car makers.

stories.headline: Army's Iowa blast put on hold
stories.summary: Trump ordered the Army to pause a plan to detonate five tons of lead azide in Iowa.

stories.headline: Omar home-search records unsealed
stories.summary: Records from the October search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home were unsealed.

stories.headline: First Gen Z woman wins US House seat
stories.summary: Melat Kiros, 29, a Democrat, became the first Gen Z woman in Congress.

stories.headline: Seven-goal thriller stuns Inter
stories.summary: Tresoldi's hat-trick condemned Inter to a historic defeat at San Siro.

subtitle: Ten stories that defined the day — from Kyiv to Kinshasa.
